#!/bin/bash

# Diagnostic Collection Script
# Logs CPU usage, memory state, and disk health status

echo "=========================================="
echo "System Diagnostics Collection"
echo "Timestamp: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "=========================================="
echo ""

# CPU Usage
echo "--- CPU USAGE ---"
echo "Current CPU Load:"
uptime
echo ""
echo "CPU Details:"
lscpu | head -20
echo ""

# Memory State
echo "--- MEMORY STATE ---"
echo "Memory Usage:"
free -h
echo ""
echo "Memory Details:"
cat /proc/meminfo | head -10
echo ""

# Disk Health Status
echo "--- DISK HEALTH STATUS ---"
echo "Disk Usage:"
df -h
echo ""
echo "Disk I/O Statistics:"
iostat -x 1 2 2>/dev/null || echo "iostat not available"
echo ""

# Process Information
echo "--- TOP PROCESSES ---"
echo "Top 10 CPU consuming processes:"
ps aux --sort=-%cpu | head -11
echo ""
echo "Top 10 Memory consuming processes:"
ps aux --sort=-%mem | head -11
echo ""

# System Information
echo "--- SYSTEM INFORMATION ---"
echo "Kernel: $(uname -r)"
echo "Uptime: $(uptime -p)"
echo "Hostname: $(hostname)"
echo ""

echo "=========================================="
echo "Diagnostics collection completed"
echo "=========================================="
